# Four lines. Two metros. Two regions. Failover sits between the regions. `/title`

Customer · Dedicated Interconnect 99.99% · two metros, two regions `/kicker`

VLAN IDs, EAD, and BGP sit on the hops. A reader following the lines sees four attachments, not one bundled cable. `/lede`
